posts.caption:
Stop jumping rope like this. Both feet, big jump, pause on every landing.

It's more pounding on your knees, less speed, and you gas out fast.

Skip it like a boxer. One foot at a time, low and quick, like running in place. In this clip I'm at about 155 steps a minute.

Save this for your next cardio day and send it to the guy at your gym who jumps like a kangaroo.

#over40 #jumprope #fitnessover40 #homeworkout #fatloss

6 weeks of crunches. Zero belly fat lost. 7 ab exercises, 5 days a week.

Ab endurance went up. Belly fat didn't change compared with the group that skipped ab work. Vispute et al., Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research, 2011.

At 38 I was 200 lb doing hundreds of crunches. I saw none of them.

Abs are a body-fat number, not a rep count.

Save this for the next time someone tells you to do 100 crunches a day.

#over40 #sixpackabs #fatloss #abworkout #fitnessover40

3 moves. 3 minutes. No gym. 1 minute on each move.

Spiderman plank: knee to the same side elbow, keep your hips level, alternate sides.

Toe touch crunch: legs straight up, reach for your shoes, and lower slowly.

Plank up-down: forearms to hands one arm at a time, hips square, and switch your lead arm.

Screenshot this, do it tonight, and tag the friend who says he has no time.

#homeworkout #abworkout #over40 #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs

Stop doing towel rows like this. Hold the towel loose and you're just waving your arms.
That's why so many guys think towel rows are a scam.
Pull the towel apart hard before you row. Stay tense the entire set.
My boy Mike Chang used to karate chop people's towels. If yours collapses, pull harder.
Save this for your next home workout. Send it to the guy who says towel rows are a scam.
#over40 #homeworkout #formcheck #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs

Stop deadlifting like this. A rounded back is the biggest reason I see guys get hurt.
Look at the ceiling, or the sky if you're outside. When you're looking up, you can't really have bad posture.
Bend your legs, not your back. Use it most when you're tired. That's when posture slips.
Save this for your next leg day. Send it to the guy who deadlifts staring at his shoes.
#over40 #formcheck #kettlebell #fitnessover40 #homeworkout

Stop doing side laterals like this. If your elbow isn't high, your delt isn't really being worked.
Lead with your elbows, not your hands, and stop at shoulder height.
Tilt the dumbbells like you're dumping out two jugs of water. Then lower slow.
Go light, 5 or 10 pounds. No rocking.
Save this for your next shoulder day. Send it to the guy whose side laterals look like a chicken dance.
#over40 #shoulders #formcheck #fitnessover40 #homeworkout

Stop doing V-sit twists like this. If you just move the ball, you're not really working as much.
Balance on your butt, knees up. Move your legs to one side and bounce the ball there, then switch.
The ball is just a counterweight.
Do them after toe touches so your obliques take over.
Save this for your next ab day. Send it to the guy who does V-sit twists like he's passing the salt.
#over40 #abworkout #sixpackabs #formcheck #fitnessover40

3 ab moves. 10 reps each. 3 rounds. Jog in place 30 seconds between rounds.
Toe touches. Lie flat, arms overhead, and jackknife up. Picture kneeing yourself in the face.
V-sit twists. Balance on your butt, legs to one side, bounce the ball on the other.
Spiderman planks. Elbows up to a push-up position and back down.
New? Do 1 round. Start with no weight. I use a 4 lb ball.
Save this for your next ab day.
#over40 #abworkout #sixpackabs #homeworkout #fitnessover40

3 moves. 90 seconds. Every commercial break, and you're back before the game comes back.
Push-ups for 30 seconds. Chest all the way down. Too hard? Do them from your knees.
Squats for 30 seconds. Sit back like there's a chair behind you, then stand up tall.
Plank for 30 seconds. Squeeze your abs, no butt in the air.
That's 30 minutes by the end of the game. Comment how many breaks you made.
#over40 #homeworkout #fatloss #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs
